summary: Frontend-only test of the redesigned Gachard home page ('/'). All requested UI sections render correctly (navbar, hero, featured cards, why, how-it-works, CTA band, footer). Sticky glass navbar becomes more opaque on scroll (0.35 -> 0.72). Logged-out routing for 'Explore Cards' and 'Open First Pack' correctly redirects to /login. Mobile drawer opens with all 6 links + Login. Fixed one data-testid generation bug for the 'Top Up' entry (space -> hyphen). No console/runtime errors observed.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid for 'Top Up' was generated with a space ('nav-link-top up' / 'mobile-nav-top up') instead of the expected hyphenated form ('nav-link-top-up' / 'mobile-nav-top-up') because label.toLowerCase() was used without hyphenating spaces. FIXED by testing agent (added .replace(/\s+/g, '-')).

issues: Hero content uses .reveal keyframe animations with animation-fill-mode: both and staggered delays. First-paint screenshots (headless) captured before animation runs render the block as visually empty even though DOM opacity computes to 1 shortly after. Real users see the animation complete normally, but this is fragile for automated visual testing / users with prefers-reduced-motion. Consider adding a prefers-reduced-motion fallback that skips the translate/opacity transform or setting the initial state to opacity:1 with a subtle fade-in only.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add a prefers-reduced-motion media query in globals.css to make .reveal accessible/less fragile (currently 'both' fill-mode leaves opacity:0 if animation is delayed/blocked).

OPTIONAL: The hero-card testids are named hero-card-lumora/pyrax/noxel but the actual card visuals rendered on the fanned stack show different character names (e.g., AURELIA NEXUS, AQUORIS SENTINEL). If the intent is to keep the testids aligned with visible names, rename accordingly.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar.tsx data-testid generation used raw label.toLowerCase() which breaks on multi-word labels. Fixed.
app/page.tsx is 674 lines — consider splitting Hero, FeaturedCards, WhyGachard, HowItWorks, CTABand into separate components in /components for maintainability.

External logo image is loaded from customer-assets.emergentagent.com via next.config allowlist — occasional slow load led to logo mark being blank in some renders while the wordmark stays. Consider inlining the logo mark as SVG or bundling it locally to avoid third-party dependency on the primary brand asset.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all listed features verified after 1 testid fix)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Home page ('/') is fully functional for logged-out users; no /api/credits calls are made (verified). Reveal animations may cause flaky visual snapshots in headless mode — force-complete via `document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => { el.style.animation='none'; el.style.opacity='1'; el.style.transform='none' })` before taking screenshots. Nav backdrop scroll behavior confirmed. Mobile drawer working. All requested data-testids now present including nav-link-top-up and mobile-nav-top-up.
